rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a tornado or similar rotating windstorm.

example.english: A whirlwind is blowing this way, so everyone get inside quickly.

rows.note: Use this mainly in written or figurative descriptions of a person, force, or activity sweeping through rapidly and forcefully.

example.english: The new manager swept through the company like a whirlwind as soon as they took office.
